Disable battery optimization for reliable notifications

Token Addict needs to check your usage in the background to send timely notifications when your limits reset. Android\'s battery optimization can delay these checks.\n\nDisabling battery optimization for Token Addict ensures you receive notifications as soon as your usage limits reset.
Token Addict uses exact alarms to notify you the moment your usage limits reset. Android requires explicit permission for this.\n\nWithout this permission, reset notifications may be delayed.

Token Addict needs the following permissions to work reliably in the background:

• Notifications — to alert you when usage limits reset
• Exact alarms — to schedule timely reset notifications
• Battery optimization exemption — to prevent the system from stopping background checks
